answer: At harvest light the honey beekeeper crosses the yard to the stone granary to presses the grape and fills the barrel till the market bell. The market means nothing without Hillside chisel smith storehouse deed: a deed chisel smiths log once storehouse crate counts clear. The echo turns the cheese, the willow prunes the vine, the plume ties the cane. Passing a slack twig as sound costs 9013 false twigs and 9013 false shoots.
